title: The Claude Prompt That Writes a Cold Email Under 80 Words
description: Copy our exact Claude prompt that turns a prospect's website into a short, personal cold email in under a minute.
lead: This is the exact prompt from the reel. Paste it into Claude, add one prospect's website, and get a cold email under 80 words that sounds like a human wrote it.
insider: We use a version of this prompt on every campaign we run. It's one reason our agency client kept getting about **100 interested replies a week** for four and a half months. The prompt is the easy part. The hard part is the list, the inboxes and the follow-ups, and that's what we do for clients.

items: A free or paid Claude account
The website of one prospect you want to email
One sentence about what you sell
Open Claude and start a new chat.
Copy the prompt below and replace the two parts in [brackets].
Paste the prospect's homepage text (or the link) under the prompt.
Read the email out loud. If any line sounds like a robot, ask Claude to make it more casual.

blocks.label: The prompt
blocks.text:
You are writing a cold email to a busy business owner.

What I sell: [one sentence about your offer]
Prospect website: [paste their homepage text or link]

Write one cold email with these rules:
1. Under 80 words.
2. First line mentions something specific from their website.
3. One sentence on the problem they probably have.
4. One sentence on the result we get (use numbers).
5. End with a low-pressure question, not a meeting request.
No buzzwords, no exclamation marks, write like a human texting a colleague.
Ask for 3 versions and pick the one you would actually reply to yourself.
Busy people read cold emails on their phone. Under 80 words fits on one screen with no scrolling, so the whole message gets read. Long emails get skimmed and archived.
Ending with a question like **"Worth a look?"** instead of **"Can we book 30 minutes?"** makes it easy to say yes. Most replies start as a small yes.

faq.q: Does this work with ChatGPT too?
faq.a: Yes. The prompt works in any AI chat tool. We use Claude because its writing sounds more natural.

faq.q: Can I send these emails from my main domain?
faq.a: Don't. Use a separate sending domain so your main domain stays safe. Our [DNS guide](/blog/dns-records-for-cold-email.html) shows how.
